prompt: Fit a line to the supplied points and return slope and intercept.
python:
xs = [0, 1, 2, 3]
ys = [1, 3, 5, 7]
mx = sum(xs) / len(xs)
my = sum(ys) / len(ys)
slope = sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(xs,ys)) / sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xs)
{"slope": slope, "intercept": my - slope * mx}
